name: What is the difference between pre-construction planning and design?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between pre-construction planning and design?

acceptedAnswer.text: While closely related, pre-construction planning and design are distinct but integrated phases. Design focuses on the aesthetic and functional aspects of the project, creating blueprints and material specifications. Pre-construction planning encompasses broader project management, including budget forecasting, scheduling, risk assessment, and coordinating with various stakeholders, based on the approved design. A practical tradeoff is that extensive design changes late in the pre-construction phase can significantly impact timelines and costs, making early and thorough design decisions crucial.
acceptedAnswer.description: Design focuses on aesthetics and blueprints; pre-construction planning covers budget, schedule, and overall project management based on the design. Late design changes impact costs.
